copy.tagline: 用JTBD和HMW方法定义问题并验证用户画像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在产品早期系统化地定义和验证问题
copy.tagline_en: Frame problems using JTBD, HMW, and persona validation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically define and validate problems in early product stages

howto.what: 按JTBD方法生成Job Story，再转为How Might We问题，从Notion数据库查找相关用户画像，最后从功能、情感、社交三维度验证问题完整性，输出格式化报告。
howto.when: 在DIVERGE循环的Ask模式开始时，或当你探索新功能/问题空间时，或需要明确问题定义时触发。也可手动用“use problem-framing skill”调用。

say.text: 帮我用JTBD方法分析这个需求：用户想快速切换工作区。
从Notion查找相关用户画像，验证这个问题。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a Job Story in JTBD format, reframes it into a How Might We question, fetches relevant user personas from Notion database, and validates the problem across functional, emotional, and social dimensions, outputting a formatted Problem Framing report.
howto.when_en: When starting a DIVERGE loop in Ask mode, exploring a new feature/problem space, or needing clear problem definition. Also invocable manually with 'use problem-framing skill'.

say_en.text: Use JTBD to analyze this need: a user wants to quickly switch workspaces.
say_en.note: Generates Job Story and HMW question.

say_en.text: Look up relevant personas from Notion to validate this problem.
say_en.note: Fetches Personas and checks three dimensions.
